name: Shungu Dutiro
shortBio: Co-founder of ExtraTIME with Henry Nzuzi, sharing a personal football story and ambitions for ExtraTIME in Meet The Founders.
bio:
Shungu Dutiro co-founded ExtraTIME with Henry Nzuzi. In "Meet The Founders || Passion to Purpose", the founders share their own personal football stories and ambitions for ExtraTIME: the genesis, the vision, the cause and the movement.

ExtraTime is a platform on the mission to empower young people to realise the importance of self-value and authenticity. Detaching your identity from what you do to who you are in pursuit of your craft.
